# Failures classified as upstream Liger Kernel issues on DevLab GPUs.
# The DevLab workflow reports these as warnings; any other failure fails the job.
# Format: <fnmatch pattern on the pytest node id> | <reason, one line> | <upstream issue URL, or "not filed">

# transformers 5.23.0 (2026-11-13) removed the model-specific *CausalLMOutputWithPast
# classes that liger_kernel/transformers/model/output_classes.py subclasses, so the
# Liger* output classes are never defined and these imports fail. Any GPU; not AMD-specific.
test/transformers/test_monkey_patch.py::*qwen2_vl* | transformers 5.23 removed Qwen2VLCausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/transformers/test_monkey_patch.py::*qwen2_5_vl* | transformers 5.23 removed Qwen2_5_VLCausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/transformers/test_monkey_patch.py::*qwen3_vl* | transformers 5.23 removed Qwen3VL(Moe)CausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/transformers/test_monkey_patch.py::*qwen3_5* | transformers 5.23 removed Qwen3_5(Moe)CausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/transformers/test_monkey_patch.py::*glm4v_moe* | transformers 5.23 removed Glm4vMoeCausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/convergence/*mini_qwen2_vl* | transformers 5.23 removed Qwen2VLCausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/convergence/*mini_qwen2_5_vl* | transformers 5.23 removed Qwen2_5_VLCausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/convergence/*mini_qwen3_vl* | transformers 5.23 removed Qwen3VL(Moe)CausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/convergence/*mini_qwen3_5* | transformers 5.23 removed Qwen3_5(Moe)CausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed
test/convergence/*mini_glm4v_moe* | transformers 5.23 removed Glm4vMoeCausalLMOutputWithPast; Liger output class missing (ImportError) | not filed

# LigerMLP (ops/mlp.py gemm_swiglu): every autotune config needs more than the 64 KB
# of LDS these GPUs have (OutOfResources 72-80 KB) in fp16/bf16, and fp32 autotuning
# runs past the 900 s test timeout. gfx1151 and gfx1201 alike.
test/transformers/test_mlp.py::test_correctness_* | LigerMLP gemm_swiglu autotune configs exceed 64 KB LDS (16-bit) / fp32 autotune exceeds 900 s | not filed

# bf16 parity tests that need bit-identical math between Triton and torch eager:
# ROCm's tanh/rsqrt differ from torch's by 1-2 ulp in fp32 (Triton's bf16 rounding is
# correct RNE, checked), which flips single bf16 roundings past the tolerances.
test/ops/test_rope.py::*dtype1-nvidia-triton* | bf16 rope: 1-ulp bf16 differences exceed atol/rtol 1e-2 | not filed
test/ops/test_fused_add_rms_norm.py::test_fused_add_rms_norm_correctness[dtype1-* | bf16 dw: 1-3 elements past tolerance | not filed
test/ops/test_norm_lora_parity.py::*dtype1] | bf16 weight-grad parity: a few elements past atol 1e-2 | not filed
test/transformers/test_modulated_rms_norm.py::test_correctness[*-dtype1-* | bf16 scale grad: 1-8 elements past atol 0.1/rtol 0.02 | not filed
test/transformers/test_geglu.py::test_correctness[dtype1-* | bf16 GEGLU MLP output vs torch with atol/rtol 1e-2 on unscaled randn weights | not filed

# Storage-lifetime test: one parameter combination fails per run, a different one each
# time, on both GPUs (StorageWeakRef still alive). Not reproducible on demand.
test/ops/test_fused_linear_cross_entropy.py::TestFusedLinearCrossEntropyAddmm::test_chunk_storage_released_before_next_chunk_and_final_cast* | flaky on ROCm: a chunk storage is still live at the check | not filed

# Mini-model convergence: Pixtral vision loss differs at one step by just over the
# tolerance (fp32 rel 1.1e-5 vs rtol 1e-5; bf16 3568 vs 3472 vs rtol 1e-2).
test/convergence/*/test_mini_models_multimodal.py::test_mini_model_vision[mini_pixtral-* | Pixtral loss one step past tolerance | not filed

# gfx1151 only, deterministic (same values every run): bf16 Llama4 mini-model with the
# fused-linear-cross-entropy path; reference loss 1.719 vs Liger 1.046 at step 9 (one step).
# fp32 llama4 and the bf16 with-logits variant pass on gfx1151; all pass on gfx1201.
test/convergence/bf16/test_mini_models.py::test_mini_model[mini_llama4-* | gfx1151 only: one-step loss divergence (1.72 vs 1.05) in bf16 Llama4 with FLCE | not filed
